memory: Established: threshold ≈5.05 Hz; slope ≈19.6°/Hz. Pooled quadratic bias ≈+39 °/Hz^2 after gain correction (g≈0.975±0.015 at 12 cm). Azimuthal modulation ~2.1 °/Hz^2 at 12 cm, minimum ≈60°. Negative-q symmetry holds. Current position: asymmetry is primarily in probe head but has a measurable standoff-dependent component; must map phase/amplitude versus distance.
